title_as_printed: Apparent molar heat capacity C_p,phi of NaCl(aq); m0 = 1 mol kg-1; C0 = 1 J K-1 mol-1

footnotes_as_printed.a: The apparent molar heat capacity was calculated from equation (1) using the heat-loss correction factor f calculated from the 2.9836 mol kg-1 value at 17.70 MPa and the calibration results of White and Wood. The f values at 373.38 K were calculated by a two-stage process as described in the text. The densities were from the equation of Gates and Wood.
footnotes_as_printed.b: The estimated accuracy delta of each C_p,phi/C0 value was calculated assuming absolute errors of +/-0.00015 and relative errors of 1 per cent in DeltaP/P.
footnotes_as_printed.c: Delta is the value of {C_p,phi(calculated) - C_p,phi(observed)}/C0. The calculated value is from the spline interpolation of the knots in table 1.
footnotes_as_printed.d: These values were not included in the least-squares fit because the initial molality is outside the range of the fit.
footnotes_as_printed.e: These values were not included in the fit because the square of the residual was greater than 20 per cent of the sum of the squares of all the residuals.

pressure_note: flow calorimeter with Grove back-pressure regulator; p printed in each block label (1.87 to 17.90 MPa); gauge calibrated against a Heise gauge, reported pressures accurate to +/-0.25 MPa

T.note: temperature of the experiment = block temperature plus one half of the temperature rise (typically 1.5 K)

value.what: apparent molar heat capacity of NaCl calculated by the authors from Ps/Pw via eq (1) with f, densities and water cp

value2.what: measured electric power ratio, solution to water (primary measured quantity)

value3.what: specific heat capacity ratio of solution to pure water at T and p, eq (1)

skip_rows.reason: T/p/f block label rows (also carried by group_rows)

extra_unmapped: Delta (deviation of the authors' cubic-spline surface from the observation, footnote c)
f (heat-loss correction factor printed in the block labels)
notes: Two side-by-side column groups per block, stacked left group first, then right group; the 398.77 K / 10.10 MPa block continues from page 136 to page 137: its left rows of both pages come first, then its right rows of both pages. Delta cells printed only as footnote letter d (26 rows, molality 3.97 to 4.99 mol/kg outside the fit range) or e (2 rows: 373.38 K/10.30 MPa m=0.0503 Cp,phi -8.49 and 451.99 K/5.05 MPa m=0.0503 Cp,phi -269.29) are written empty with note Delta:d or Delta:e. The e mark is printed very small and could also read c; e is the only footnote that fits. Block label for 349.01 K is printed without the unit K; the 349.07 K label prints f = 1.06 (other 349 K blocks 1.046). Molalities printed as m/m0 with m0 = 1 mol/kg. Exact replicate rows kept (e.g. 498.70 K: 0.4260 / -202.62 printed in both column groups).
